title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Cheddar Rice
ingredients: 1¼ pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into natural 1-inch bite-size pieces
1¼ cups uncooked long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained
½ teaspoon salt, or to taste
instructions: Step 1: Pat the chicken dry and cut it into natural bite-size pieces, keeping them fairly even so they cook at the same rate. Season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt.

Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook until golden-brown around the edges and fully cooked inside. Add 1 tablespoon butter and half the garlic during the final minute and toss until every piece is coated. Transfer the chicken to a plate.
Step 3: Lower the heat to medium. Add another tablespoon butter and the remaining garlic. Stir in the rice and cook for about 1 minute, then pour in the chicken broth.
Step 4: Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook over low heat for 18–20 minutes, until the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and let it rest covered for 5 minutes.

Step 5: Stir in the remaining butter, milk, heavy cream, cream cheese, cheddar, and Parmesan until the rice is thick and creamy. Fold all of the garlic Parmesan chicken pieces back into the rice, mixing well so the chicken is evenly distributed throughout. Finish with parsley.
notes: Approximately 710 calories per serving. Top comment from a reader who made it: "Made it last night! It's a keeper recipe... We used chicken thighs, amazing." Source post is AI-labeled content on Facebook (page: Homemade Cooking Recipes).
